gui.unboundmaps.guide1:
• Create: double-click the map, or RMB -> 'Create waypoint here'.
• Edit/delete: RMB on a marker -> 'Edit' / 'Delete'.
• Quick delete: hover the marker and press Del.
• List of all waypoints: the B key.
• Teleport: RMB on the map -> 'Teleport here'.
• A beacon draws a light column in the world, visible from far away.
gui.unboundmaps.guide2:
• Name - the label above the marker on the map and in the world.
• X/Y/Z - coordinates; Y sets the height of the beacon beam base.
• Color - the marker square color and the beam color.
• Beacon - toggle the light column for this waypoint.
• Death points are created automatically: 'Death point' is where you died last, 'Old death point' - earlier deaths. Colors and the beacon are configured on the settings page.
• Stay within 3 blocks of a death point for 5 seconds and it disappears.
gui.unboundmaps.guide3:
• Open the search: Ctrl+F.
• Plain text - searches your waypoints.
• way/<name> - waypoints only.
• block/<block> - blocks in loaded chunks: block/diamond_ore, block/#ores.
• biome/<biome> - biomes over the WHOLE explored map: biome/desert, biome/#jungle.
• Enter - run the search and cycle results, Esc - close.
• Results are highlighted with rings, the current one is white.
gui.unboundmaps.guide4:
• The slider in the bottom-left corner is the view height. Leftmost position = Auto.
• In Auto the slice engages when you are underground (disable with 'Auto cave mode').
• C - pin the height at the player's level or go back to Auto.
• The , and . keys (or the mouse wheel over the slider) move the slice by 8 blocks.
• In slice mode the map shows the world 'without a roof' - all caves below the chosen height.
gui.unboundmaps.guide5:
• Z - enlarge the minimap: centered on the screen or in the same corner (see 'Enlarged minimap centered').
• 'Minimap position' - which corner it lives in.
• Zoom: the 'Minimap zoom in/out' keys (= and - by default).
• Map dots are your waypoints; the radar shows nearby entities.
• Under the map: cave mode, coordinates and biome.
gui.unboundmaps.hint: Drag: pan | Scroll: zoom | RMB: menu | Double-click: new waypoint | Del: delete marker | B: waypoint list | C: cave mode | Ctrl+F: search | M/Esc: close
